title: Ultra-Detailed Studio Portrait
desc: Creates photorealistic 8K portrait photography with natural studio lighting.
prompt: A cinematic studio portrait of [Subject], soft box lighting, 85mm lens, depth of field, sharp focus on eyes, ultra-realistic skin texture, 8k resolution, photorealistic render --ar 16:9 --v 6.0

title: Viral Social Media Post Creator
desc: Writes high-converting hooks and structured posts for LinkedIn & Twitter.
prompt: Act as a viral content strategist. Write a 5-part social media post about [Topic]. Start with a powerful hook line to stop scrolling, use short scannable sentences, add 3 actionable tips, and finish with a strong call-to-action.

title: ATS-Optimized Resume Tailor
desc: Customizes your bullet points and executive summary to match any target job description.
prompt: Act as a professional career coach. Tailor my resume bullet points for a [Target Job Title] role. Rewrite these accomplishments to sound impact-driven using strong action verbs, numbers, and key skills required for this position: [Paste Experience]

title: SEO Article & Outline Generator
desc: Creates complete blog posts structured to rank high on Google search.
prompt: Act as an SEO expert. Write an engaging 1000-word article on [Insert Keyword/Topic]. Include an optimized Meta Description, H1 Title, H2/H3 Subheadings, key bullet points, and a concluding Summary with FAQ section.

title: B2B Sales Outreach Email
desc: Short, personalized 4-sentence email designed for high response rates.
prompt: Write a concise cold outreach email offering [Your Service/Product] to a [Prospect's Title] in [Prospect's Industry]. Make it personal, highlight one major pain-point solution, and end with a low-friction meeting request.

title: Code Debugger & Optimizer
desc: Detects errors in your code, fixes bugs, and explains the solution clearly.
prompt: Act as a Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer. Analyze the following code snippet for bugs, performance issues, and best practices. Provide the corrected code and briefly explain what changes were made: [Paste Code]
